source_results.statement: Finite-order Hecke L-functions over Q(sqrt(-3)), all Dirichlet L-functions, including Riemann zeta, have no zeros for Re(s)>7/8, excluding principal poles at s=1.
Separate manuscript claims a weaker fixed zero-free region for Hecke over Q(sqrt(-3)) and Dirichlet L-functions, explicitly referring to 7/8 paper as stronger.
For primitive nonprincipal real Dirichlet character with conductor q>=3, any real zero beta in (0,1) satisfies (1-beta)log(q)>=c, where c>0 absolute.
